correctness.rationale: For increments from consecutive permutation comparisons, the pair of edges around each odd vertex contributes 2 exactly when S_{2k-1}>0, so N_{2n}=2Σ1_{D_{2k-1}≤k-1}. Conditioning on the previous rank-r permutation and using Eulerian insertion yields E[π_r|des=d]=r-d and E[U_r|des=d]=(r-d)/(r+1). Only the comparison sharing U_r remains correlated with early event; the covariance becomes a positive Eulerian absolute-deviation sum with factor 2r/(r+1). For independent signs, martingale orthogonality gives ΣE|W_{2k-1}|; variance of Eulerian descents (r+1)/12, Cauchy-Schwarz and exact binomial absolute moments give strict termwise smaller C_n. One-dependent CLT plus uniform integrability yields n^{3/2} constants. Direct exhaustive independent enumeration for n=1,2,3 reproduced the exact covariances. The arcsine marginal and beta-binomial variance are correctly cited as prior results, not derived from the finite check.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks corroborate indicated identities; unrestricted assertions are supported by proof reconstruction, not by finite tests.
